label: Multi language code extractor uses pluggable backend registry with web tree sitter pinned to 0.20.8 for grammar ABI match evidence chunk 2
title: Multi language code extractor uses pluggable backend registry with web tree sitter pinned to 0.20.8 for grammar ABI match evidence chunk 2
summary: LOAD-BEARING GOTCHA: web-tree-sitter MUST be pinned to 0.20.8 to match the tree-sitter-wasms@0.1.13 grammar ABI (those grammars are built with tree-sitter-cli@^0.20.8, language version 14). web-tree-sitter@0.25+/0.26 has a newer loader that REJECTS the older-ABI grammars with an opaque 'Error at failIf/getDylinkMetadata' during Language.load. If you bump web-tree-sitter, you must also rebuild/upgrade the grammars to a matching ABI. The 0.20.8 API: default-exported Parser, Parser.init(), Parser.Language.load(wasmPath), node.namedChild/childForFieldName/startPosition(0-based rows); Language.query(scm).captures(root).
